title: Getting to Buenos Aires — official City of Buenos Aires tourism site
publisher: Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires
claims: Ezeiza International Airport (EZE) is about 32 km from the centre of Buenos Aires and the journey to the centre takes about 50 minutes.
Jorge Newbery Airport (AEP) is inside the city in Palermo and is within 25 minutes of the main hotels.
AEP mainly serves domestic flights and flights to neighbouring countries; most long-haul international flights use EZE.
Tienda León runs buses from Ezeiza airport to the city.
